turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nan is leaving her big house and nobody knows what to do with all her furniture.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A house clearance company could take it all in one day, but we'd get almost nothing for it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cousin wants to sell the nice pieces online one by one, which could make money but take months.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we split it between the family and donate whatever's left to the hospice shop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Splitting it between the family first feels right, since some pieces will mean a lot to people. Then a hospice shop for the rest is quick and kind, and you can still sell anything really valuable.
